topic: ILT20 season to feature international stars Klaasen, Miller, and Finn Allen
headline: ILT20 SEASON TO SIZZLE WITH HEINRICH KLAASEN, DAVID MILLER, FINN ALLEN, AND MORE IN UAE
summary: The fourth edition of the International League T20 (ILT20) is set to start in the United Arab Emirates, featuring six teams and 34 matches. The tournament has been brought forward to avoid a clash with the 2026 T20 World Cup. International stars such as Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller, and Finn Allen will participate in the league. The ILT20 will run until January 4, with Dubai Capitals defending their title. The league allows up to nine overseas players per team, with no plans to reduce this number.
